text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We're all rough gems that just need<n>a bit of
polishing before we can shine.<n>It's important that
you believe in the<n>possibilities you possess and
never<n>give up.

text_block_list.text: Let's come back and try again<n>sometime!
